findings: Native985680 transforms point by world then view then projection with individual SSE scalar operations; perspective divide is followed by viewport mapping.

Exact-zero homogeneous W returns zero and leaves output untouched. The wrapper9854F0 ignores that return, so its zero-W output uses uninitialized local data and is deliberately excluded from port qualification.
Native depth mapping is(ndcZ+1)*0.5+viewportMinZ; the viewportMaxZ field is not consumed by985680.
Native9854F0 remaps viewport coordinates to render target size and accepts depth in[0,1), XY in inclusive target bounds.
runtime_adapters: All985680 projection arithmetic executes without adapters; fixtures supply matrices and viewport.
Compound9854F0 includes actual985680; driver viewport retrieval, world-matrix initialization/provider and security cookie adapted.
limits: Historical matrices/viewport producers and live camera interoperability remain open. Fixture matrices are explicit numerical inputs, not claimed historical initialization.
Native x87 extended arithmetic may differ outside the tested cases; no universal precision equivalence claimed.
